2026-09-28 21:07:14.925963 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-09-28 21:07:14.925985 | controller |
2026-09-28 21:07:14.926047 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-09-28 21:07:14.926127 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-09-28 21:07:14.926132 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-09-28 21:07:14.926187 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-09-28 21:07:14.926721 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-09-28 21:07:14.929302 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-09-28 21:07:14.929312 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
